name: PutnamGAP
description: PutnamGAP is a benchmark dataset containing multiple mathematically-equivalent variations of advanced competition-level math problems designed to evaluate the robustness of LLMs in mathematical reasoning against linguistic and parametric perturbations.
reputation: A recent robustness-focused math benchmark that has seen growing interest in evaluating whether models truly solve problems rather than memorize surface forms.
notes: Evaluates LLM robustness to mathematically equivalent transformations of advanced math problems, revealing sensitivity to non-mathematical perturbations.
